opening: A person is 30 meters away from his car, but he only took five steps to get in the car. Why is this?
solution: He works on a high floor. He takes the elevator down to the underground garage to get in his car. His car is parked right at the underground elevator entrance.
canonical_facts: The person works on a high floor.
He uses an elevator to reach the underground garage.
His car is parked immediately beside the underground elevator entrance.
